proof_body:
by
  intro G _ h
  let Z := Subgroup.center G
  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ Z) := Subgroup.finite_quotient_of_finiteIndex
  have hsub : commutatorSet G ⊆ Set.range (fun p : (G ⧸ Z) × (G ⧸ Z) => p.1.out * p.2.out * p.1.out⁻¹ * p.2.out⁻¹) := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, b, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨((a : G ⧸ Z), (b : G ⧸ Z)), ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z ∈ Z, (a : G ⧸ Z).out = a * z := by
      refine ⟨a⁻¹ * (a : G ⧸ Z).out, ?_, by group⟩
      exact (QuotientGroup.eq).1 (QuotientGroup.out_eq' _).symm
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w ∈ Z, (b : G ⧸ Z).out = b * w := by
      refine ⟨b⁻¹ * (b : G ⧸ Z).out, ?_, by group⟩
      exact (QuotientGroup.eq).1 (QuotientGroup.out_eq' _).symm
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hw
    have cz := Subgroup.mem_center_iff.1 hz1
    have cw := Subgroup.mem_center_iff.1 hw1
    simp only [hz2, hw2, commutatorElement_def]
    have e1 : a * z * (b * w) * (a * z)⁻¹ * (b * w)⁻¹ = a * (z * b) * (w * z⁻¹) * a⁻¹ * w⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by group
    have e2 : a * (b * z) * (w * z⁻¹) * a⁻¹ * w⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = a * b * (z * w * z⁻¹) * a⁻¹ * w⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by group
    have e3 : a * b * (w * z * z⁻¹) * a⁻¹ * w⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = a * b * (w * a⁻¹) * w⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by group
    have e4 : a * b * (a⁻¹ * w) * w⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = a * b * a⁻¹ * b⁻¹ := by group
    rw [e1, ← cz b, e2, ← cz w, e3, ← cw a⁻¹, e4]
  haveI : Finite (commutatorSet G) := ((Set.finite_range _).subset hsub).to_subtype
  infer_instance
